definition: to cook food so it is ready to eat
description: At a busy street food market at night, a young woman in a black vest top, a patterned bandana and a brown apron stands at a steel counter and tosses noodles, prawns and spring onions in a black wok over a gas burner. A tall burst of orange flame and steam shoots up into the dark blue sky, then new flames flare up from the wok as she keeps tossing. Bowls of chopped green onion and red chilli stand in front of her, and a crowd under strings of light bulbs watches behind her.

de.answer: Sie bereitet Nudeln in einem Wok zu.
de.question: Was macht die Köchin?

es.answer: Está preparando fideos en un wok.
es.question: ¿Qué está haciendo la cocinera?

fr.answer: Elle prépare des nouilles dans un wok.
fr.question: Que fait la cuisinière ?
